ability.settings.name: Settings
settings.emptyText: No ability has injected configuration options yet.
settings.searchEmptyText: Try different keywords — search matches category names and setting content.
settings.caption: Settings injected by each ability · search matches categories and individual settings
theme.title: Theme
zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.label: Scale
font.title: Font
font.familyPlaceholder: Noto Serif CJK SC / LXGW WenKai
font.caption: Default uses the bundled Noto Sans CJK stack; Follow system uses the platform UI font; Custom requires an installed font family name (empty falls back to default).
window.title: Window
launch.title: Launch
desc.快捷键: Shortcuts injected by abilities (all unbound by default): bind / rebind / clear, disable a whole group, searchable
shortcut.hint: Every shortcut is unbound by default — enable the ones you want: click a key, then press the new combination. Esc cancels, Backspace / Delete clears. By default works only while the window is focused and needs a modifier (except F1–F12); turn on "Global" to trigger it anywhere (needs two or more modifiers; Wayland may show a system permission prompt).
shortcut.globalNeed2: Global shortcuts need at least two modifiers
shortcut.globalUnsupported: Global shortcuts are not supported on this system
shortcut.globalTaken: Global registration failed: taken by another app or refused by the system
screenshot.title: Screenshot mode
screenshot.switch: Enable screenshot mode (adds a camera button to the title bar)
screenshot.hint: Left-click: capture this window and save. Right-click: add to the merge queue (badge shows the count). With a non-empty queue, left-click merges it into one image. Middle-click clears the queue. Saved to Pictures/Cockpit Screenshots and copied to the clipboard. Shortcuts are unbound by default — enable them in Settings → Shortcuts. Raw capture with no privacy masking, user-only — AI can neither see nor click it. Handy for judging aesthetics yourself.
desc.截图模式: Title-bar camera: left-click saves, right-click stacks several shots
sidebar.title: Sidebar Sorting
sidebar.caption: How the sidebar entries (grouped by category) are ordered. Frequency and recent are read from apps.csv — opening a sidebar entry or launching an app increments the counters.
sidebar.customHint: Drag cards to reorder sidebar entries. Newly added abilities will be placed at the bottom.
sidebar.statsHint: Frequency / recent are based on apps.csv; clearing resets all counters immediately.
desc.侧边栏: Sidebar sort rules: alphabetical / frequency / recently used / custom
about.title: About
about.text: Configuration driven by ~/.config/LinuxCockpit/; abilities live under src/abilities.
animation.title: Page Transition
animation.caption: Transition effect when switching between sidebar abilities.
animation.modernMotionCaption: Master switch. On: theme changes ripple outward from a configurable origin, and page transitions are enabled. Off: all motion is disabled and themes swap instantly.
animation.themeTransitionCaption: Where the new theme expands from when switching: the top-left corner, or the current mouse position.
window.note: frameless/rounded take effect on next launch; background/fuse apply instantly. Layers: Background (bottom) → Fuse (middle) → Data (top). Fuse at 100% fully hides the background; lower it to reveal it. Image visibility = background opacity × (1 − fuse overlay opacity).
desc.外观: Theme, zoom, window, fuses, dashboard, launch and about
desc.字体: Global interface font: default Noto / follow system / custom family
desc.界面动画: Modern motion master switch & page transitions
desc.settings.appearance: Theme, UI scale, window chrome, background & Fuse overlay, launch & about
desc.settings.appearance.font: Global interface font: default Noto / follow system / custom family
desc.settings.appearance.window: Frameless, rounded corners, background & Fuse overlay
desc.settings.appearance.animations: Modern motion master switch, page transition animations
settings.languageCaption: Switch language — reloads the page to apply.
settings.ability.title: Ability Toggle
settings.ability.description: Enable/disable abilities at runtime (current session only, not persisted). Disabled abilities' sidebar entries and commands are hidden immediately.
settings.ability.disabled: {name} disabled (sidebar entry and commands hidden immediately)
desc.settings.appearance.sidebar: Sidebar sorting: alphabetical / most used / recent / custom
desc.settings.abilities: Runtime ability toggles (temporary, not persisted; disabled abilities hide from sidebar & commands immediately)
sidebar.modeCaption: On narrow screens such as phones the sidebar takes too much width. In pop-up mode it is hidden; tap the menu button at the top left to open it, and it closes after you pick a page.
sidebar.modeAuto: Auto (pop-up on narrow screens, docked on wide ones)
window.blurModeHint: Frosted glass (the blur behind translucent panels, the sidebar and menus) and background-image blur are expensive on phones; the pop-up sidebar may drop frames when it opens.
window.blurAuto: Auto (off on narrow screens, e.g. phones)
window.blurOff: Off (panels get a more solid background)
settings.outsider.title: Allow abilities to show floating panels
settings.outsider.description: When off, no ability can show a floating panel; you can also expand an ability below to block it alone. YAYA's AI presence panel and consent prompts are not affected.
settings.outsider.master_off: All ability panels are turned off above
settings.outsider.none: No ability declares a floating panel yet.
label.在浏览器 / 手机上打开同一个 Cockpit: Open this same Cockpit in a browser / on your phone
web.title: Web access
web.hint: Open this same Cockpit in a browser or on your phone: it shares the desktop app's process, so background tasks, the player and settings exist only once.
web.headless_mode: This process is the headless host (web access is set by its launch options):
web.lan_warning: Plain HTTP: anyone on the same network with the token link gets full control of Cockpit. Only enable on trusted networks.
web.not_built: Web assets are not built yet: run pnpm build:web (pnpm build includes it)
web.token_hint: The token in the link works like a password — don't share it.
